intended_use: churros shops, bakeries, dessert counters, food trucks, events, and short-range takeaway or delivery
not_recommended_without_additional_engin: long hot holding, high-moisture foods, or direct food contact without an approved material and barrier specification
structure: a fold-flat corrugated tuck-top box with front locking tabs, side walls, a hinged lid, and a shallow serving footprint
fit_inputs: churros length and diameter, pieces per serving, sauce-cup position, liner or grease sheet, stacking count, hold time, temperature, and handoff method
insert_direction: optional paper dividers, sauce-cup retainers, grease-resistant sheets, or no insert when the food layout and liner are sufficient
print_information_direction: a high-impact lid and front panel, menu or reheating guidance where appropriate, allergen and legal copy supplied by the operator, and unprinted safety margins on food-contact surfaces when required
material_direction: food-use paperboard or corrugated board with any grease or moisture barrier selected against the real food, temperature, contact type, and destination regulations
content_positioning: International B2B custom-manufacturing product page; no stock-size, price, lead-time, certification, or performance assumptions.
